declarations.docstring: A finite linearly independent displayed family has cardinality strictly below the number of conjugacy classes when the group cardinality vanishes in the field.
A finite linearly independent family of linear functionals has cardinality below the ambient dimension if all functionals vanish on a common nonzero vector.
The quotient image of the referenced auxiliary monoid-algebra element is nonzero.
For a simple module, the referenced map sends the referenced auxiliary element to zero when the group cardinality is zero in the field.
